c.title: $4,500 / 2br - 1200ft2 - Top-Floor Penthouse 2BR/2BA | Wraparound Terraces | Ocean Views (West End)
c.description:
TEXT show contact info to book a showing, reference “Elliot Towers #1200”, leave your name, details of each occupant, preferred move-in date, and your available dates/times to view.

Available December 1

The only penthouse at Elliot Towers: 1,200 sq ft on the 12th floor, surrounded by terraces, with 180-degree views of English Bay, the North Shore mountains and the city.

There’s a fireplace in the living room and terrace access from the main bedroom. The suite is being fully renovated for a December 1 move-in. Laundry is coin-operated, in the building.

1 year minimum lease. The unit is unfurnished. Heat, hot water and bike storage are included. Parking at extra cost, if available: $120 a month underground, $100 covered or $90 outdoor, plus a $100 remote deposit. No pets, smoking, or BBQs permitted. Absolutely no sublease/Airbnb.

Elliot Towers, at 1350 Broughton Street, is a 12-storey concrete tower facing Sunset Beach. Just four homes on each floor, so every one-bedroom is a corner suite with windows on two sides. Davie Street is a short walk.

Please note: Being renovated. These photos were taken before the renovation started, so the finished suite will look different. The views are real.
